caption: The drawing depicts a watering can with a round handle on the left side and a long, narrow spout ending in a perforated rose on the right. The can is brown with decorative, painted motifs in lighter colors including white, blue, and green. These motifs include a central figure of a person in light-colored clothing, standing and holding an object above their head, as well as a patterned surface surrounding them with floral and abstract designs. The handle and spout are outlined and partially filled with blue and white accents. The watering can sits on a round, light brown wooden surface with visible grain and outlined edges. The background is a uniform, muted green color with subtle shading, creating contrast against the object in the foreground.
title: Pa. German Watering Can
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
